description: One game object (a chest, herb, ore vein or fishing pool) by the id in its GUID: the items players looted from it, each with observed loot windows, windows with the item and distinct install reports. A frequency is public after 3 install reports; a public object with nothing in its windows reads as a measured zero. Objects have no names yet. Reads Everloot's current authorized public corpus when connected.

objectId.description: The object's entry id, as in /database/objects/1731.

name: object_page

connected.description: False when no corpus was read; the page is then absent, which is not a measured zero.

dataAsOf.description: The corpus snapshot time, or null when unrecorded.

queued.description: Observations exist but fewer than 3 installs reported them.

zero.description: Public windows with no item at all: a measured zero.

reason.description: Why nothing was read, when connected is false.

url.description: The everloot.app page that shows this answer, absolute. Absent when there is no such page or it would be empty.

title: Game object page
